artists.name: Pond

Pond.biography: Pond is an Australian psychedelic rock band from Perth, Western Australia, formed in 2008. Initially featuring a revolving line-up, since 2016 the band has consisted of Nick Allbrook, Jay Watson, Shiny Joe Ryan, Jamie Terry, and James Ireland.

perplexity.description:
Tasmania, released on 1 March 2019, is the eighth studio album by Australian band Pond. Musically, the album blends psychedelic rock with electronic elements, showcasing the band's signature fusion of lush synth textures, driving guitar lines, and atmospheric production. The record features a polished yet adventurous sound, balancing catchy melodies with experimental flourishes, and reflects the band's evolution from their earlier, more lo-fi recordings to a more refined and expansive sonic palette.

Within Pond’s discography, Tasmania follows the critically acclaimed The Weather (2017) and continues the group’s exploration of genre-blurring songwriting. The album was released via Marathon Artists and received positive reviews for its inventive arrangements and cohesive vision, with critics noting its blend of pop sensibility and psychedelic experimentation. While not a major commercial breakthrough, Tasmania was well-received by fans and critics alike, solidifying Pond’s reputation as one of Australia’s most innovative rock acts.
